items.title: AWS Cannot Restore Data Held Only in Damaged Middle East Availability Zones
items.blurb: AWS has told customers it cannot restore resources and data hosted exclusively in the mec1-az2 availability zone in the UAE, or exclusively in the Bahrain region, after damage during the conflict with Iran.

items.title: Lambda MicroEgg
items.blurb: It’s an egraph that supports well-scoped alpha aware binders.

items.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in the South America (São Paulo) Region
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X8i instances are available in the South America (São Paulo) region. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors available only on AWS.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer can now import evaluation form PDFs using AI
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now lets managers import a PDF of an evaluation form from a third-party quality management application, and automatically recreates it in Connect using AI, making it easier to migrate an existing quality program…

items.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor Monetization Functions adds ad response hooks
items.blurb: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now supports two additional lifecycle hooks for monetization functions: post ad decision server (ADS) response, and pre manifest insertion.

items.title: Amazon ECS extends Amazon S3 Files support to the Amazon EC2 compute type
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now supports Amazon S3 Files for tasks running on the Amazon EC2 launch type, enabling customers to connect their containerized applications directly to data in Amazon S3 as a shared file…

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets you create, manage, and search custom metrics through APIs
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer provides a library of standard metrics. Custom metrics let you go further; defining the measurements unique to your business.

items.title: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) is now generally available in 11 additional Regions
